title: The 6-step tour is short and points at the real controls
why: Each bubble sits next to the thing it describes (Project panel, Run first pass, Selects, timeline, Ask-the-AI box, File) and says what happens in plain words; 'Nothing changes until you accept' is reassuring.

title: Typing the folder path and Enter made a new project instantly
why: Toast 'opened copper-02-2026 · new project'; title, Program and timeline renamed; 26 clips listed, first clip loaded in Source within ~5 s.

title: Clip posters scrub when you move across them; single click loads Source
why: Icon view looked like CapCut's media grid; hovering moved the poster through the clip and a click put it in Source.

title: The proposal explains every shot in plain story terms
why: Each of the 18 rows says why it's there ('Cold open… I'm milked out… sets up the milk thread that the ending pays off'), plus 'THINGS TO CHECK' where the AI says what it's unsure of. Reads like an assistant editor's notes, and found a running joke through the trip I'd have missed.

title: The AI's descriptions of shots matched the pictures
why: Of 10 claims I checked against the footage, 7 were plainly right (skier in shorts with arms out, milk jug drinking, group sprawled by the lodge…), 2 partly, 1 weak; none made up. It even flagged its own shakiest claim as 'unsupported'.

title: 'Cut it to about 90 s' worked in one ask
why: Typed one sentence in the Ask box; ~80 s later a new proposal of 15 shots / 1:33.0 appeared, laid under my cut with the removed shots struck through in red on V1, each change explained. It even dropped the 25 s dark bathroom story, which was one of my three dislikes.

title: Rotation + Scale in Effect Controls fixed the sideways shot like Premiere would
why: Selected shot 2, typed -90 in Rotation and 178 in Scale; the Program monitor immediately showed the airport bar right way up and full-frame. (First try 90° gave upside-down — trial and error, but quick.)

title: Asking 'rotate it like shot 2' worked in 10 s
why: With shot 3 selected, the Ask box scoped itself to 'Shot 3 · GX010474'; the AI read what I'd done by hand on shot 2 and proposed exactly Rotation -90 + Scale 178 as two tickable edits with a live After preview.

title: 'Get to the snow faster' came back in 20 s as 5 plain, tickable edits
why: Ripple delete 2 travel shots, trim 2, start a run earlier and add a new GX010493 run — each with its own ✓/✗, and an explanation in one paragraph. Exactly what I'd have done by hand in 5 minutes.

title: Export dialog is clear and shows exactly where the file will go
why: Preset 'Quick 1080p' with a one-line explanation, file name, full path to the .mp4, duration 1:32:22 and an estimated size; like Premiere's but simpler.

title: The exported film is right: 93 s, 1080p, sound, sideways shots fixed, ski half all there
why: film_sheet of copper-trip-for-friends.mp4: 93.0 s, 1920x1080 23.976, stereo AAC; 16 frames cover airport bar (upright), plane laptop gag, shorts skier, runs, milk jug finale. Export took ~52 s with a live 'encoding 00:00:59 of 00:01:32' readout.

title: Double-clicking 'Make a first cut' started only one job
why: Progress showed in the top bar with a % and '~2 min left', and the job's stage under the button; the clumsy double click did not start two runs (only one 'AI revision' item appeared).

title: Delete-all is one Ctrl+Z away and says so
why: Toast 'removed 18 shots — Ctrl+Z brings them back', then 'undone: remove' and the whole cut was back, waveform and all.

title: A running first pass survives a tab reload
why: F5 mid-run came back showing 'First pass · the cut ~1 min left ×' and 'working out the shape · 0:17' in the Assistant, and it finished normally.

title: 'make it 60 seconds' worked
why: Typed in Ask the AI; ~60 s later a 15-shot 1:00.1 proposal, with note 'I cut the film from 145.6s to exactly 60.0s', red-marked removed shots on V1 and the proposal on its own lane.

title: Nonsense input 'x' got a plain, helpful answer in 3 s
why: 'I'm not sure what "x" means here… Say "mark clip" and I'll set it… for example "cut shot 7"' — no edit made, no job left running. An empty Enter did nothing (no error, no job).

title: The AI understood a long German paragraph and echoed it back in German
why: 'Neuschnitt: Skifahren nach vorne, Flughafen auf einen kurzen Moment kürzen, Abschluss mit der ganzen Gruppe am Berg, höchstens 60 s.' — clear summary of what it will do before doing it.

title: The German re-cut did what I asked and the claims hold up
why: Proposal 16 shots 0:49.1 opens 'Straight into the strongest riding' and the Program really shows a spray turn (GX010489), then follow-cam runs, lift line, ridge — the airport is gone from the front. Preview labels each shot 'proposal · GX010489 0:10.4–0:13.9'.

title: Copies of a cut are safe and deleting one asks first
why: 'saved a copy as try-short — you are on it now'; I cut 2 shots on the copy (0:41) and main stayed 16 shots 0:49. 'delete' on a cut asks 'move the cut "try-short" to the bin's trash?' — the confirm the proposal Discard lacks.

title: Backspace with no shot chosen explains itself
why: 'click a shot to choose it — ⌫ takes out only a shot you selected' instead of silently deleting or silently doing nothing.

title: Window > Reset workspace layout put my dragged panel divider back in one click
why: After I dragged the Assistant panel ~290 px wider, Reset workspace layout restored the default at once. Panels can't be closed by accident (no close on tabs).

title: The proposal is impossible to miss
why: Header 'Next: Read the proposal and accept or discard it', a 'Proposal 18 of 18 · 2:55.7' ghost lane on the timeline and Accept/Discard in the Assistant with per-shot why + in/out. I knew what to do in 3 seconds.

title: Three-point editing works like Premiere
why: Marked In/Out in Source, parked on a cut with ↓, '.' overwrote and ',' inserted the exact 3:00 range at 00:00:04:04, with a toast naming the clip, range and position; sequence length stayed 2:55:12 for overwrite and grew to 2:58:12 for insert. Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z undid/redid cleanly. ~1 s each.

title: Q ripple-trim is frame accurate and needs no selection
why: Parked at 0:51:15 inside the bathroom shot, pressed Q: the head rippled away, playhead returned to the cut, toast 'in → 0:18.1 on GX010479', and the frame now at the cut is exactly the frame I parked on.

title: Drag-trim shows the frame and the numbers
why: Dragging a cut's top edge drew the new out frame in Program and a live readout 'out 4.59s · −3.42s · the rest moves · snap: word', plus a hint bar explaining top edge = ripple, bottom edge = roll, Shift flips. Better trim feedback than I expected.

title: Cutaway on V2 composites correctly
why: Once targeted alone, '.' laid the cutaway on V2 with A1 untouched; Program shows the V2 picture over the talking shot.

title: Default dissolve key and edge-drag duration work
why: Parked on a cut with ↓, Ctrl+D laid a 1 s Cross Dissolve centred on the edit and Program showed the mix; dragging the transition's edge lengthened it symmetrically (undo: 'transition duration').

title: AI copied a grade across three shots, itemised
why: Multi-selected shots 7–9, Ctrl+J 'same Lumetri look as shot 6': in ~15 s it listed 9 per-parameter edits (Contrast +20, Highlights −20, Saturation 125 per shot) each with ✓/✗, and noted it left the −6 dB volume alone because that's audio. That is what Paste Attributes should be, and a manual way to do it does not exist (see HANDS-16).

title: Everything survived a reload, and Save copy is one field
why: After reload: 13 shots, 1:29:20, the V2 cutaway, ½× speed, dissolves, Dip-to-Black fades, titles and the named 'milk line' marker were all there. Saving 'hands-v1' as a copy of the cut was one text field + button in the cut menu. Marker dialog (M on a marker) matches Premiere's.

title: Asked in plain words for 'skiing first, then flash back to the trip' and got a real structural re-cut
why: 64 s: 14.5 s ski montage of five pieces (follow-cam arms-out, carve-by, snowboarder, snow-spray 'Woo!'), then 'I'm milked out' as the hinge into the flashback, then back to the slope. Every shot has a why, the 'things to check' were honest (wind may cover the line in GX010493), and I could untick one shot and 'Accept 17 of 18'. The montage frames really are sunny skiing.

title: 'Add a title that says Copper 2026 over the first shot' just worked
why: 8 s to a proposal, ~30 s for the designed effect (with a 'checking… → ✓ checked' state), Preview showed a big clean 'Copper 2026' fading over the follow-cam shot, gone before the cut.

title: Re-running one stage on one clip is easy and shows progress
why: Index › select clip › pick stage (Look) + interval (every 1 s) + engine (Claude only) › Run. The detail row said 'Looked at running 0:06 · ~46%' live and finished in 31 s; the clip then reads 'every 1 s (tuned)' and the header '25 at 4 s, 1 at 1 s'. That is exactly the 'what ran and how to tune it' answer.

title: Finding and accepting the AI's cut is obvious
why: Top bar said 'Next: Read the proposal and accept or discard it', Assistant panel had PROPOSED CUT 18 shots 2:55.7 with Play it / Accept / Discard, and a 'Things to check' list naming specific clips and timecodes. One click, 'applied — undo with Ctrl+Z' toast, Next moved on to 'Make the film — quick look'.

title: Designed Effects made a working opening title from one sentence
why: Typed what I wanted (text, white sans, centred, title-safe, 0.5 s fades). It came back as a named PROPOSED effect with '✓ checked', Preview/Accept/Discard/Change, and the preview showed the exact words with real fade-in and fade-out.

title: Cross Dissolve drag-and-drop works like Premiere and is honest about handles
why: Dragged Cross Dissolve from Effects onto the edit between shot 9 and 10: toast 'Cross Dissolve · 1.00 s at the edit — insufficient media — repeated frames', hatched block on the edit when zoomed, and the monitor shows the blend at 1:31:01.

title: Lumetri Scopes work and read true
why: Waveform + vectorscope of the parked graded shot (1:55:22, alpine look): snow sits at ~85–90, nothing clipped at 100, sky pulls toward blue on the vectorscope. Good enough to grade by.

title: Export reports where the file is and what it is
why: Done dialog: 'Exported copper-v1-master.mp4 · 175.68 s · 3840×2160 · 23.976 fps · 647 MB · Master 4K'; Show file reveals the full server path with Copy path; Export panel keeps an inline player, '↓ Download 647 MB' and 'Older films (1)'. Exact length and fps kept.

title: Cancel Export is clean and safe
why: Cancel at 18% gave 'Export cancelled. Nothing was written.'; no partial file in the folder and the earlier copper-v1-quick.mp4 was untouched (same size and time).

title: Versions are one field away
why: Cut menu (click 'copper-02-2026 main'): 'save a copy as…' + 'work on the copy' + Save copy → toast 'saved a copy as v2 — you are on it now', top bar reads 'copper-02-2026 v2'. Look, effects, transitions carried over.
